description: This file contains utility functions and classes for pre-processing and enriching API requests in the Litellm proxy server environment. It handles header processing, user metadata extraction, callback configuration, guardrails management, and request augmentation prior to forwarding to LLM providers.

classes.name: KeyAndTeamLoggingSettings
classes.description: Helper class providing static methods to retrieve dynamic logging settings based on API keys and team metadata, supporting conversion and merging of callback configurations.

classes.name: LiteLLMProxyRequestSetup
classes.description: Contains static methods to prepare and enrich request data, including headers, metadata, callback configurations, guardrails, and tracing information, prior to forwarding to LLM providers.
